import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0080 (a b c : List α) : (a ++ b) ++ c = (c.reverse ++ b.reverse).reverse ++ a.reverse := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0080 (a b c : List α) : (a ++ b) ++ c = (c.reverse ++ b.reverse).reverse ++ a.reverse := by
  induction a with x xs ih
  · simp [List.reverse_cons, List.append_assoc, List.reverse_append]
  · simp [List.append_assoc, ih, List.reverse_append, List.reverse_cons, List.append_assoc, List.reverse_append]
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0080 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0080 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0080

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0080
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0080
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
